senses.gloss:
निवक्षस् नि-वक्षस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, Ved. (pro-
bably) an epithet of the sacrificial animal (implying
some peculiarity of colour &c.).

निवचन 1. नि-वचन, अम्, n. (fr. rt. वच्
with नि), Ved. expression, address; a proverbial
expression; [cf. 1. निर्-वचन.]

निवचन 2. नि-वचन, अस्, आ, अम् (नि = निस्),
(Pāṇ. 1. 4, 76), not speaking; [cf. 2. निर्-वचन.]
—निवचने-कृ, cl. 8. P. -करोति, -कर्तुम्, to
obstruct the speech, to cease to speak.
—निवचने-
कृत्य or निवचने-कृत्वा, ind. having ceased to
speak.

निवत् नि-वत्, त्, f. (fr. नि), Ved. a steep
place, a valley; (ता), ind. downhill, downwards.

निवध् नि-वध्, a defective verb (see वध्),
to kill.

निवना नि-वना, ind., Ved. downwards,
downhill; [cf. नि-वता.]

निवप् नि-वप्, cl. 1. P. A. -वपति, -ते,
-वप्तुम्, to scatter seed, sow; to offer, make offer-
ings of cakes &c. to the Manes; to kill.

नि-वपन, अम्, n. pouring out, scattering or
throwing down; sowing; oblations or gifts in
honour of deceased ancestors, an offering to the
Manes; [cf. निर्-वपण.]

नि-वाप, अस्, m. seed, grain, seed corn; an oblation
or offering to the Manes of deceased parents or
relatives, a libation or offering of water &c. at the
Śrāddha; gift, offering in general.
निवाप नि-वाप, &c. See नि-वप्, col. 1.
नि-वापक, अस्, m. a sower.

निवापिन्, ई, इनी, इ, pouring out, throwing or scat-
tering down, sowing.
निवर नि-वर. See नि-वृ, p. 504, col. 1.

नि-वर, अस्, m., Ved. covering, protection, a
protector; (Sāy.) a preventer, obstructer; (आ), f. a
virgin, an unmarried girl, (in this sense probably fr.
नि, ‘not,’ + वर, ‘a husband.’)
निवार नि-वार. See नि-वृ, p. 504, col. 1.

निवर्त नि-वर्त, नि-वर्तन, &c. See नि-
वृत्, p. 504, col. 1.

नि-वर्त, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. causing to return or
turn back.
निवर्हण नि-वर्हण. See नि-वृह्, p. 504.

नि-वर्हण, अस्, आ, अम्, destroying, extirpating,
annihilating, removing; (अम्), n. destruction, eradi-
cation, annihilation, killing, removing; [cf. नि-बर्-
हण.]

निवस् 2. नि-वस्, cl. 2. A. -वस्ते, -वसितुम्,
to put on or wear (clothes), dress; to change one's
clothes: Caus. or cl. 10. P. -वासयति, -यितुम्, to
put on (a garment?).
नि-वसत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, dwelling in, inhabiting.

नि-वसति, इस्, f. a habitation, abiding, abode,
house, residence.
नि-वसथ, अस्, f. a village.

1. नि-वसन, अम्, n. a dwelling, house, a habita-
tion. (For 2. see under 2. नि-वस्, col. 2.)

2. नि-वासन, अम्, n. (for 1. see under 1. नि-वस्,
above), (with Buddhists) a kind of raiment.
नि-वस्तव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be lived; to be spent.

1. नि-वास, अस्, m. (for 2. see under 2. नि-वस्,
col. 2), living, dwelling, residing; passing the night;
a place of residence, dwelling-place, abode, house;
night-quarters.
—निवास-भूमि, इस्, f. place of
residence.
—निवास-भूय, अम्, n. habitation; in-
habiting.
—निवास-राजन्, आ, m. the king of the
country in which one dwells.

2. नि-वास, अस्, m. (for 1. see under 1. नि-वस्,
col. 1), dress (e. g. in चर्म-निवास, dressed in a
skin).

निवाश नि-वाश, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. वाश् with
नि), Ved. bellowing, roaring, sounding.

1. नि-वासिन्, ई, इनी, इ, dwelling, abiding in, inhabit-
ing, an inhabitant, resident.

2. नि-वासिन्, ई, इनी, इ (at the end of a comp.),
dressed in, wearing, clothed, covered.

नि-वासय (fr. 2. नि-वास), Nom. P. निवासयति,
&c., to put on (a garment), to cover.

निवह् नि-वह्, cl. 1. P. A. -वहति, -ते,
-वोढुम्, to bring or lead near; to carry, to support.

नि-वह, अस्, m. a multitude, quantity, heap, (in
this sense also आस्, m. pl.); N. of one of the seven
winds; one of the seven tongues of fire.

नि-वाह, अस्, m., Ved. leading down, (opposed to
अभ्य्-अवरोह.)

निवात 1. नि-वात, अस्, आ, अम् (नि = निस्),
protected against or sheltered from the wind, not
reached by the wind, not windy, calm [cf. 2. निर्-
वात]; (अम्), n. a place sheltered from or inac-
cessible to the wind, a sheltered spot, (sometimes
used at the end of a comp. of which the first member
expresses the sheltering object, see Pāṇ. VI. 2, 8);
a calm.

निवात 2. नि-वात, अस्, आ, अम् (नि + वात fr.
वन्), unimpeded, unhurt, uninjured; secure, safe
(as in an asylum); well armed, accoutred in strong
mail; (अस्), m. an asylum, a refuge, a dwelling, &c.;
an impenetrable coat of mail; (अम्), n. security, a
secure spot; strong armour.
—निवात-कवच, अस्,
आ, अम्, whose armour or mail is impenetrable, wear-
ing an impenetrable coat of mail; (अस्), m., N. of a
demon, the grandson of Hiraṇya-kaśipu; (आस्), m.
pl., N. of a class of Dānavas or Daityas.

निविड नि-विड, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. विड = विल,
a hole, with नि = निस्), without spaces or interstices,
close, contiguous, coarse, large, bulky; gross, thick,
impervious, impenetrable, dense, firm; crooked-
nosed; (अस्), m., N. of a mountain.

निविडय, Nom. P. निविडयति, &c., to make
tight.

नि-विडीस, अस्, आ, अम्, compact, close; coarse,
gross; crooked-nosed (?).
नि-विरीस or नि-विरीश = नि-विड.
निविरीस नि-विरीस. See नि-विड, col. 1.

निविद् 1. नि-विद्, cl. 2. P. -वेत्ति, -वेद, -वे-
दितुम्, to tell, communicate, proclaim: Caus. -वेद-
यति, -यितुम्, to make known, tell, communicate,
report, represent, betray, relate (with dat., loc., or gen.
of the person); to present, offer, give, deliver.

2. नि-विद्, त्, f., Ved. instruction, information, direc-
tion, communication, precept, doctrine; invocation;
N. of certain sentences or short formularies inserted
in a liturgy and containing epithets or short invoca-
tions of the gods (e. g. अग्निः सुषमित्, होता देव-
वृतः); (Sāy.) speech, a short text of the Veda.
—निविद्-धान, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. containing the
Nivids; (अम्), n. (according to Sāy.) inserting the
Nivids.
—निविद्धानीय, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. containing
the Nivids.
नि-वेदक, अस्, आ, अम्, communicating, relating.

निवेदक नि-वेदक, नि-वेदन, &c. See
under 1. नि-विद्, p. 503, cols. 2, 3.

नि-वेदन, अस्, आ, अम्, proclaiming, announcing;
(अस्), m. an epithet of Śiva; (अम्), n. making
known, proclaiming, apprizing, publishing, relating,
communicating, announcement, communication; in-
formation; representation; delivering, giving, en-
trusting; an offering, oblation; dedication.

नि-वेदयिषु, उस्, उस्, उ (fr. the Desid. of the
Caus. without reduplication), wishing to make known
or report, intending to relate about.

नि-वेदिन्, ई, इनी, इ, communicating, reporting,
relating, proclaiming.

1. नि-वेद्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be communicated or
related; fit to be reported; (अम्), n. an oblation,
offering food to an idol, (probably for नैवेद्य.)

2. नि-वेद्य, ind. having respectfully announced
or made known.

निविवृत्सत् नि-विवृत्सत्, नि-विवृत्सु. See
p. 504, col. 2.

नि-विवृत्सत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत् (fr. the Desid.), wishing
to return or desist.

निविश् नि-विश्, cl. 6. A. -विशते (ep. also
P. -विशति), -वेष्टुम्, to enter; to alight, descend;
to sit down, take a seat; to lie down; to settle
down, to encamp; to settle, take a wife; to be fixed
or intent on (with loc.): Caus. -वेशयति, -यितुम्,
to cause to enter, introduce, place in or on; to cause
to sit down; to cause to settle or dwell, cause to lie
down or encamp; to cause to marry; to put or
place down; to found (a city); to enter (in writing),
mark down (letters, lines, &c.), inscribe (on a tablet),
depict; (with मनस्) to apply the mind to, fix the
mind on (with loc.).

नि-विष्टि, इस्, f., Ved. entering (a female), copu-
lation.

नि-वेश, अस्, m. entering, entrance; settling in a
place, encamping, halting; dwelling-place, habita-
tion; halting-place, place of lying, camp, palace, the
residence of a king or general, (निवेशं कृ, to take
up one's residence, settle, encamp); depositing, de-
livering; founding (a household), settling, marrying,
marriage; founding (a town); impression, mark,
copy; military array; ornament, dress, decoration.
—निवेश-देश, अस्, m. a dwelling-place.
—निवेश-
वत्, आन्, अती, अत् (at the end of a comp.), lying in or
on, resting on.

नि-वेशन, अस्, ई, अम्, entering; placing or laying
down, lodging, providing with a resting-place; (अस्),
m., N. of a Vṛṣṇi; (अम्), n. entering, entrance;
sitting down, encamping, settling, putting or laying
down, (निवेशनं कृ, to settle, encamp); entering
(in writing), inscribing; founding (a household), mar-
rying, marriage; resting-place, habitation, dwelling-
place, abode, dwelling, house; a nest; a camp; a
town or city; [cf. अ-न्˚.]

नि-वेशनीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be entered; to be
fixed; to be engaged in.

नि-वेशयत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, causing to enter, intro-
ducing, sending in or into.

नि-वेशिन्, ई, इनी, इ, resting in, being in, situated
on, lying near; resting on.

1. नि-वेश्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be founded (as a town);
to be married (as a man); to be returned or paid.

2. नि-वेश्य, ind. having placed in or on, having
made to remain or dwell.

निवेष्य नि-वेष्य, अस्, m. (fr. rt. विष् with
नि), Ved. a whirlpool, a water-spout; a whirlwind
or any similar phenomenon [cf. स्तनयित्नु]; a part
of the upper or fore-part of an animal, the vertebra?;
(according to Mahī-dhara) eddy or hoar-frost; (अस्,
आ, अम्), whirling, belonging to a whirlpool or eddy.

नि-वेष्टव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be married (applied
to a man); (अम्), n. to be married, (used impersonally,
e. g. महाकुले निवेष्टव्यं सदृशे वा, one
should marry into a high family or an equal).

निविशेष नि-विशेष, अस्, आ, अम्, not differ-
ent, alike; (अस्), m. want of difference.

निवीत नि-वीत, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. व्ये with
नि), having the sacred Brāhmanical thread suspended
round the neck; (अम्), n. wearing the Brāhmanical
thread round the neck; the Brāhmanical thread so
worn; (अस्, आ, अम्), m. f. n. a veil, mantle, a
wrapper (= नि-वृत).

निवीतिन्, ई, इनी, इ, wearing the sacred thread sus-
pended round the neck; (ई), m. a Brāhman with
the cord so suspended.

निवीर्य नि-वीर्य, अस्, आ, अम्, impotent (=
निर्-वीर्य, q. v.).

निवृ नि-वृ, cl. 5. 9. 1. P. A. -वृणोति,
-णुते, -वृणाति, -णीते, -वरति, -ते, -वरितुम्, -व-
रीतुम्, to surround, defend, restrain: Caus. -वार-
यति, -यितुम्, to surround, protect; to keep off,
ward off, prohibit, hinder, prevent, hold back from,
stop, withhold, forbid, interdict, exclude, obstruct,
oppose: Caus. Pass. -वार्यते, to be interdicted,
to be withheld.

नि-वारक, अस्, आ, अम्, keeping off, defending,
able to keep off.

नीवारक, अस्, m. rice growing wild or without
cultivation.

नि-वारण, अस्, आ, अम्, keeping off, preventing,
defending; (अम्), n. keeping back or off, preventing,
defending, hindering, opposing; prohibition, an im-
pediment; contemning (?).

नि-वारणीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be kept off or de-
fended, to be checked or hindered, &c.

नि-वारयत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, preventing, opposing,
hindering.

नि-वारित, अस्, आ, अम्, hindered, forbidden, pre-
vented, checked, opposed.
1. नि-वार्य = नि-वारणीय.

2. नि-वार्य, ind. having suppressed, having for-
bidden.

नि-वार्यमाण, अस्, आ, अम्, being prevented or
hindered.

नि-वृत, अस्, आ, अम्, surrounded, enclosed, en-
compassed; (अस्, आ, अम्), m. f. n. (= नि-वीत), a
veil, a mantle, a wrapper.

नि-वृत्त, अस्, आ, अम्, returned, returning, turned
back; gone, departed; vanished; ceased, refrained
from, abstained, stopped, desisted, prohibited; abstain-
ing from worldly acts, &c.; abstaining, abstracted or
abstained from or independent of worldly acts or
motives, abstracted from this world, quiet; desisting
from or repenting of any improper conduct; finished,
completed, whole; (अम्), n. return; [cf. दुर्-न्˚.]
—निवृत्त-कारण, अस्, आ, अम्, without further
cause or motive; (अस्), m. a virtuous man, one
uninfluenced by worldly desires.
—निवृत्त-कृषि-
गोरक्ष, अस्, आ, अम्, ceasing from agriculture and the
tending of cattle.
—निवृत्त-देव-कार्य, अस्, आ, अम्,
ceasing from sacrificial rites or offerings to the gods.
—निवृत्त-मांस, अस्, आ, अम्, one who abstains
from eating meat.
—निवृत्त-यज्ञ-स्वाध्याय, अस्,
आ, अम्, ceasing from sacrifices and the repetition of
prayers.
—निवृत्त-राग, अस्, आ, अम्, of subdued
appetites or passions.
—निवृत्त-वृत्ति, इस्, इस्, इ,
quitting any practice or occupation.
—निवृत्त-
हृदय, अस्, आ, अम्, with relenting heart.
—निवृत्-
तात्मन् (˚त-आत्˚), आ, m. ‘one whose spirit is ab-
stracted,’ a sage; an epithet of Viṣṇu.
नि-वृति, इस्, f. covering, enclosing.

निवृज् नि-वृज्, cl. 7. 1. P. -वृणक्ति, -वर्-
जति, -वर्जितुम्, Ved. to immerse, drown; to over-
throw; to pour out; to extirpate.

निवृत् 1. नि-वृत्, cl. 1. A. (also P. in Fut.
Cond. and Aor.) -वर्तते, -वर्तितुम्, to turn back,
return, retreat, retire, go back, turn back or away
from (with abl.); to recoil; to escape from (with
abl.), run away; to cease from, desist from, abstain
or refrain from (with abl.); to refuse, decline; to
cease; to come to an end, be accomplished; to be
finished, stop, set (as the sun); not to occur; to be
withheld; to be forbidden; to be reversed; to be
occupied or engaged in: Caus. -वर्तयति, -यितुम्,
to cause to return; to bring back; to turn away,
keep back from, restrain; to cause to desist; to drive
back, repel; to accomplish, perform, bring to an
end, (for निर्-वृत्.)

नीवृत् नी-वृत्, त्, त्, त्, m. f. n. (fr. वृत् with
नि), any inhabited country, a realm.

नि-वर्तक, अस्, इका, अम्, returning, turning or
coming back, flying; desisting from, stopping, ceasing;
bringing back, causing to cease, abolishing, expelling,
removing.
—निवर्तक-त्व, अम्, n. the state of one
who turns back, &c.

नि-वर्तन, अस्, आ, अम्, turning back, ceasing, ceas-
ing to exist, disappearing; causing to return; (अम्), n.
returning, turning or coming back, return; ceasing,
not happening, not occurring; desisting or abstaining
from (with abl.); desisting from work, inactivity,
(opposed to प्र-वर्तन); repenting, reforming;
[]
causing to come back, bringing back; turning back
(the hair); a means of returning (Ved.); keeping
back from (with abl.); a measure of land, 20 rods
or 200 cubits or 40,000 Hastas square.
—निवर्तन-
स्तूप, अस्, m., N. of a Stūpa erected at the spot
where the charioteer of Buddha returned.

नि-वर्तमान, अस्, आ, अम्, turning back, re-
turning.

नि-वर्तयितव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be kept back,
to be restrained, to be diverted.

नि-वर्तित, अस्, आ, अम्, turned back or away,
brought back, made to desist.
—निवर्तित-पूर्व,
अस्, आ, अम्, one who has turned away before.
नि-वर्तितव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be brought back.

नि-वर्तिन्, ई, इनी, इ, turning back, returning, flying,
(सङ्ग्रामाद् अ-निवर्तिन्, not turning back from the
fight, i. e. not flying); leaving off, abstaining from;
allowing to return, causing to turn back.

नि-वर्त्य, ind. having turned or brought back,
having induced to desist; having desisted or refrained
from; having repented; having repaid; [cf. दुर्-न्˚.]

नि-विवृत्सु, उस्, उस्, उ, desirous of turning back,
wishing to desist.

निवृह् नि-वृह् [cf. नि-बृह्], Caus. -वर्ह-
यति, -यितुम्, to throw down; to annihilate; to
extirpate.

नि-वर्हित, अस्, आ, अम्, destroyed, annihilated,
eradicated.

निवेष्ट नि-वेष्ट, अस्, m. (fr. rt. वेष्ट् with
नि), a cover, envelope; वसिष्ठस्य निवेष्टस्,
N. of a Sāman.
नि-वेष्टन, अम्, n. covering, enveloping, clothing.

निव्याध नि-व्याध, अस्, m. (fr. rt. व्यध्
with नि), Ved. an opening, aperture, a window.
नि-व्याधिन्, ई, इनी, इ, Ved. piercing, opening.

निव्यूढ नि-व्यूढ, अम्, n. perseverance,
resolution.

नीव् नीव् [cf. rts. तीव्, पीव्, मीव्], cl. 1. P.
नीवति, नीवितुम्, to become fat or cor-
pulent.

नीव नीव, अस्, m. a species of tree; [cf.
नीप.]

नीवन् नीवन्, आ, m., N. of one of the ten
horses of the Moon.

नीवि नीवि, इस् and ई, f. (probably fr. rt. व्ये
with नि), a cloth worn round a woman's waist or the
ends of the cloth passed round the loins so as to
hold the whole together; a petticoat; the tie or
encircling band of a woman's drawers; the outer tie
of a packet in which the offerings of a Śūdra at
funeral obsequies are presented; capital, principal,
stock; a stake at play, stake, wager.
—नीवि-भार्य,
अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. to be worn in an apron, &c.

नीव्र नीव्र, अम्, n. the edge of a thatch,
the edge or side of a sloping roof; a thatch, a roof;
a wood; the circumference of a wheel; the constel-
lation Revatī; the moon; [cf. नीध्र.]
